How SpaceX filmed its biggest rocket using its own satellites
caption:
SpaceX put cameras on six of its internet satellites and caught Starship on film during its 13th flight. This shot is stitched from four cameras on a single satellite.

Starship is the largest rocket ever built. Ground footage never shows its real scale, but seeing it from another spacecraft in orbit does.
